items.title: The Aspirant
items.description: The official webtoon of how Layla and Fanny, rivals at Selrick Academy, first fight side by side against the Enders of Terrinia.
items.note: The text beside the pages is a transcript, lightly cleaned. Lines marked Scene describe the picture. The transcript covers pages 1 to 42.

lines.t: We don't quite know when. But at some point, cyborgs appeared in our world.
Like demons, they almost completely wiped out human civilization.
The trembling survivors knew them by one name...
The Enders!
Humanity retreated to a final bastion in their bid for survival
Terrinia

It shows a technologically advanced city of tall buildings, with a lake in the middle that joins the ocean. The whole city lies on a shore. Half of it is a human city and a large part of it is Selrick Academy.
Here they established the Selrick Academy, a place to train warriors that stand against The Enders
These warriors...
Are The Aspirants.
Selrick Academy, VR Battlefield.
A boy runs, breathing heavily. He trips and falls as a monster suddenly attacks him.
A shining cable wraps around the monster's hand and holds it. A woman flies in, holding the cable. She defeats the monster easily. This woman is Fanny.
As Fanny is about to deliver the final blow, a cannon fires a laser from far away and takes the kill. It is Layla.
If you'd led them over earlier, I could've killed them all even faster!
These 'Ender' things, huh. What pushovers!
Layla...
The mood is awkward.
Fanny scolds Layla angrily.
You idiot! What were you thinking?!
Do you even realize just how dangerous that was?!
Layla, arrogant as ever, pushes Fanny away.
Dangerous?
What, you doubt my judgement, is that it?
Fanny holds her head.
You arrogant little...
Some thanks I get for saving your life!
You could at least be grateful!
Enough arguing guys...
The two cannot stand each other. Layla was always top of the class until Fanny arrived, a transfer student whose achievements can only be described as true perfection.
Layla acts like she couldn't care less, yet deep down it leaves her bitter. And so she's always at loggerheads with Fanny.
A view of Selrick Academy: tall, industrial buildings with one tall tower in the middle that shoots a laser at the sky.
Team B3: VR training complete. Your score: 33 enemies taken out within 10 minutes.
Of these 33: Fanny defeated 15, Roger defeated 2, and Layla defeated 16.
Layla is happy that she has more kills than Fanny.
I did it!
I won! Victory is all mine!
Fanny is annoyed by her attitude.
Whoa, Layla's awesome! Nice work!
Congrats Layla! You're finally not trailing along in second place anymore!
Layla is annoyed at being named second to Fanny.
Shut it!
An alert sounds in the academy.
ALERT ALERT ALERT
Ultra Enders are attacking the defense sphere in Terrinia's Northeastern sector!
Enders have already ripped an 8 by 2-meter breach!
Everyone is running and panicking.

All tutors from the combat and backup departments are requested to aid academy preparations! Advance through the academy gate portal in an orderly fashion and head to these coordinates to provide backup!
Fanny and Layla are preparing for the fight.
And now, it's our time to shine!
Hey, that's my line!
Enders are destroying Terrinia's defense shield. Civilians run for their lives.
Professor Joe is fighting and guiding civilians to safety.
Professor Joe!
You take Professor Joe somewhere safe, I'll kill this freak!
Wait!
You won't be able to take it out alone!
What's your plan then?
Cover me! I'll look for a weak spot around its neck
No way! You cover me instead!
Whatever, let's do this
The two fight together.
That day is the first time the two join forces. Miraculously, they work together quite well.
Layla uses a cannon that fires a laser. Fanny uses highly maneuverable gear to fly and strike the Ender directly.
They defeat many Enders together.
You know, we'd probably get along if you weren't so competitive all the time.
I could say the same of you
... I have an elder brother ...
An incredible fighter who I respect above anyone else
I'd longed to join him on the battlefield since I was just a kid
But the thing is.
I could never quite reach his level...
I'd think...
Maybe if I just gave it my all in each training, kept on improving...
I'd be good enough to fight alongside him one day.
Layla realizes that Fanny is not trying to put her down. Fanny is only trying her best to catch up to her brother.
All rested up?
If so, let's get back to our training!
Huh? Since when were we training?
Since right now!
They both smile.
We've gotta get stronger. After all, we're the protectors of all humanity

items.title: Guinevere and Vexana
items.description: The official webtoon about Guinevere and Vexana. Vexana is pulled into an Ender portal, holds on to her memories of Guinevere, and is shown a future by the Will of the Planet.
items.note: Pages 3, 23 and 40 are missing in the source, so the numbering of the original is kept and a notice marks each gap. The transcript covers pages 2 to 45.

lines.t: Guinevere lies on the ground, unconscious and badly injured, along with other Aspirants.
Vexana, in her normal human form, is still conscious. She kneels in a torn uniform, with injuries across her body. She cries as she looks at the scene, holding her Emblem of Hope.

Vexana's tears fall on the Emblem of Hope, but it does not light up. This means that Vexana's and Guinevere's power are not in sync. Vexana cries with despairing eyes, like a person who has lost her world.
Vexana of the Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future
You shall witness life's destruction, as all returns to chaos
This is no judgement, merely the universe's predetermined execution.
The Emblem of Hope that Vexana holds tight cracks and disappears.

This is a future that the Will of the Planet shows Vexana. It makes her desperate and determined to join the Enders and destroy them from within. It shows her that neither she nor anyone else can do anything about that future as things stand, and that she has to do something.
3 Hours ago: Academy Investigation Room Corridor
Bang Bang Bang

Guinevere and Vexana fight back to back. Guinevere uses her close combat skills and Vexana uses magic with a staff. They fight many Enders together. Suddenly an Ender comes out of a portal behind Guinevere. Guinevere is shocked and has no time to react.
Vexana runs to Guinevere and pushes her away from the Ender.
Careful, Guinevere!
As Vexana pushes Guinevere away, the Ender grabs Vexana's hand instead and drags her into the portal. Guinevere tries to save her.
No! Vexana!
It is too late. Tears fall from Vexana's eyes as she thinks it is okay to sacrifice herself as long as Guinevere is okay.
Stay back!
Vexana is dragged into the portal while Guinevere watches her face slowly disappear from view.
Vexana falls into the abyss, accepting her fate. Suddenly her Emblem of Hope lights up, and she sees hope and her past memories with Guinevere.
Past memories.
Guinevere and Vexana watch fireworks together, holding hands. Vexana looks happily at Guinevere's face while Guinevere points at a firework.
We'll be just like fireworks, shining at our absolute brightest!
As Vexana sinks deeper, she remembers more memories.

Guinevere and Vexana receive badges of honor, at a ceremony, for being the best Aspirant duo in the academy. Both smile and hold hands. Teacher Lesley smiles at them and other Aspirants celebrate in the background.
We're the best partners in The Aspirants!
Vexana holds her head. Remembering all of these memories is painful, because she is now separated from Guinevere. But the Emblem of Hope shines brighter, and her hope grows bigger too.
The Emblem of Hope shines the brightest here.
The scene changes to another memory.
Under a bright blue sky, Vexana and Guinevere rest below a shady tree on a sunny day and talk. Guinevere lies on Vexana's lap while Vexana pats her hair.
Teacher Chang'e told us,
to defeat the Will of the Planet, we must destroy the Ender's Control Core hidden in its dark void.
But we can't get near the void.
Then Guinevere gets up, excited.
Don't worry!
I will definitely
Find a way
To destroy it
The screen cracks, as if someone is trying to interrupt Vexana as she sees these memories. Big, sharp hands reach out of the cracks in her memories.
The Will of the Planet comes out of Vexana's memory.
Vexana stares at the Will of the Planet, shocked, scared and helpless.
Is this...
The only way to protect Guinevere?

Here the Will of the Planet shows Vexana a vision of a future where Planet Dawnbreak is destroyed by the Enders and nobody can do anything about it (it refers to the first panel). Vexana remembers that the Enders, or the Will of the Planet, can be destroyed by taking control of the Enders with the Ender Control Core. Vexana is determined to join the Enders and steal the Ender Control Core when she gets the chance. For now, she has to follow the orders of the Will of the Planet.
The timeline returns to the present. Vexana wears an Ender costume. Her hair has turned from black to white and her outfit represents the Enders.

Guinevere is in the academy, watching the attack. Her Emblem of Hope begins to shine and beep, which shows that Vexana is near and that their power is in sync. Guinevere is shocked, and sure that Vexana is connected to the attack.
Vexana stands on top of a building and looks down at all the attacks from the Ender side.
Betray her...
But to protect her...
Guinevere cries, knowing Vexana is still alive and that there is still hope of saving her. She touches the Emblem of Hope, which lights up, a symbol of hope.

items.title: Voice actors wanted
items.description: Fanny runs to Layla with a letter in front of a crowd at the game studio's headquarters. They are hiring voice actors for an animation series, and both cheer.

items.title: Art class
items.description: Layla and Fanny draw in art class at Selrick Academy. Layla calls her drawing a masterpiece. Fanny draws Layla perfectly, and Layla's drawing of Fanny looks like a child's.

items.title: Do you trust me?
items.description: At Selrick Academy something has run away again. Fanny asks Layla if she trusts her, then takes Layla on her back and flies. Layla is terrified.

items.title: The phone
items.description: On the battlefield Fanny sits under a sign that says "Don't touch my purple buff!" and plays on her phone. Layla passes by singing, spots the phone and tries to take it.

items.title: Wrong server?
items.description: A comedy set on the in-game battlefield. Layla and Fanny speak Japanese lines, and other heroes wonder if they joined the wrong server. Then Harley shows up in an Ultraman costume.

items.title: No time to rest
items.description: On a sunny day at Selrick Academy, Fanny enjoys the clear sky after beating an Ender. Layla says they must not let their guard down. Fanny offers a game and then ramen, and Layla says no to both.

items.title: The new skins
items.description: Layla and Fanny show off their new looks. Their friends nod, blush and cheer that they look cute.

items.title: The cook off
items.description: Fanny and Layla seem to prepare their gear, but they are in a kitchen and cooking. Each presents a dish, and the two compete over whose is better.

items.title: Valentina and the new skin
items.description: Valentina is a hero who can copy an enemy hero and its skin. Every time an expensive new skin arrives she says "Time to shine" and turns into Layla in her Aspirant skin.

items.title: Layla is kind

credit.note: The post names two artists. The pages are signed ANZSKETCH.

items.description: Fanny narrates. People think Layla is cold and has piercing eyes. The truth is that Layla is a very kind and soft person, and she asks Fanny to help a cat stuck in a tree.

items.title: Before and after the buff
items.description: Fanny before she gets the buff: she begs for help. Fanny after she gets it: she promises to carry everyone.

items.title: The morning routine
items.description: A day starts for Ruby, Angela, Fanny and Layla. Ruby wakes up, Angela and Layla are already dressed and Fanny sleeps on. They race to the school gate, and the order they arrive in is ranked at the end.

items.title: Low battery Angela
items.description: After a long match, Angela crashes into rocks and says she needs a battery. A friend asks if she is alright. Angela glitches from an overcharge, and her charge climbs to 1337 percent.

items.title: Somebody, help me!
items.description: A parody of the in-game battlefield. Fanny runs from an enemy with low health and cries for help. Ruby drops in to protect her, but Angela gives her shield and health to Ruby, who is at full health. Fanny is left crying in the corner.

items.title: Who should Angela help?
items.description: On the battlefield Fanny needs help in the jungle, Ruby is low on health and Layla is about to be ambushed. Angela is confused about whom to help first.

items.title: Keep her safe
items.description: Ruby gives Angela a task: protect Angela at all costs. She hands over a small Angela doll and says she trusts her little doll to keep her safe.

items.title: Never mind
items.description: At Selrick Academy, Ruby walks side by side with Angela. Fanny asks Angela to play, but Ruby glares from behind Angela, and only Fanny sees it. Fanny backs off. Angela is confused, and Ruby acts normal.

items.title: Angela overload
items.description: Angela asks to borrow Ruby's headpiece. Ruby says yes. Angela is so excited that she overloads.

items.title: The gacha pull
items.description: Layla stands next to a player who mains Ruby. The player tries to get a Ruby or an Angela skin from the gacha draw and gets the Angela skin instead. The player is sad.

items.title: Layla bumps Angela
items.description: At Selrick Academy, Ruby walks beside Angela. Layla sees it, gets annoyed and bumps her head against Angela's. Ruby glares at Layla when Angela is not looking. Layla leaves crying and tells Fanny, and Angela is left confused.

items.title: Meanwhile, your marksman
items.description: You fight an enemy to protect your buff. Fanny holds him off. Meanwhile Obsidia, her teammate in this joke, eats the buff in a funny way.

as-first.note: the first panel of the comic: the planet and the first lines

as-both.note: the two of them at the end

gv-first.note: the first page: fire and the first BANG

gv-gold.note: a long haired figure in golden light

gv-fall.note: falling, upside down, in blue light
